title: Distress and Target
intro: A client - either assigned to you or not has had a crisis event. They displayed aggression or self injury behavior and either in passing or directly you were involved with event.
We are tracking client relation and its influence to crisis event timeline - all data is anonymized, and what you provide will not be traceable back to you.
